stored_token.meaning: token argument stored as claimRecipient[user][token] key (on-chain mapping token)

declared_token_position.meaning: address the event declaration places in the token parameter position

declared_recipient_position.meaning: address the event declaration places in the recipient parameter position

emitted_token_topic.meaning: address actually carried in the indexed token topic of the emitted ClaimRecipientUpdated log

emitted_recipient_topic.meaning: address actually carried in the recipient topic of the emitted ClaimRecipientUpdated log

claim_recipient_set.meaning: occurrence of a _setClaimRecipient call that emits ClaimRecipientUpdated

assumptions: _setClaimRecipient is only invoked for genuine recipient updates and the emitted event corresponds to the freshly stored claimRecipient[user][token] entry.
The declared parameter order (user, token, recipient) is the authoritative ABI format consumed by off-chain indexers.
